name: tuneduel
description: TuneDuel - music quiz game. Root orchestrator for the frontend (Next.js game) and backend (Express/WebSocket audio routing).

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix backend
